name: post-main-focused
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp -a frozen-paxos/. .; root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/lane-i-post-main.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT; bun regression-driver/paxos-fix-source.ts "$root"; cd "$root"; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun test ./core/extract-standalone.test.ts ./core/counts-completion-order.test.ts ./core/count-completion.test.ts ./core/count-recovery-order.test.ts ./core/count-focus-proof.test.ts ./core/counts-preflight.test.ts ./core/count-cert-grow.test.ts; echo PAXOS_POST_MAIN_PASS focused

name: post-main-check
cmd: set -euo pipefail; cp -a frozen-paxos/. .; root=$(mktemp -d /tmp/lane-i-post-main.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf "$root"' EXIT; bun regression-driver/paxos-fix-source.ts "$root"; cd "$root"; bun install --frozen-lockfile; bun run check; echo PAXOS_POST_MAIN_PASS check
